subject: C27
required_fixes: R1 — crates/xtask/src/complete.rs:309-328; crates/xtask/src/evidence.rs:198-209; docs/architecture/native-checks.json: Implement the documentation-only native policy required by C27.md:23. The native inventory has only C01-C25, required_runs always requires NativePrepare, and expectations always loads native checks; adding an empty C27 list would still be rejected. Consequently C27 cannot obtain the promised controller receipt, and P09 native validation will also fail on C27 even after application inventories are populated. Acceptance: explicitly register C27-C34, exempt only the approved documentation-only subject from app preparation/acceptance, handle that exemption in integrated P09 validation, and test these production controller paths while preserving rejection of missing/empty inventories for application chunks.

R2 — crates/xtask/src/complete.rs:220-228,419-423,466-474: Enforce C27.md:34's exclusion from D034. Only phases reject owner acceptance; C27 currently follows the generic chunk path that can accept scores of 8, required fixes and evidence gaps. Once its other prerequisites are satisfied, this can advance every dependent chunk without the mandatory specification review. Acceptance: completion and completion recognition reject owner-accepted sub-threshold C27 receipts; production-interface tests reject C27 with any score below 9 or remaining required fixes/gaps, while preserving the approved C28-C34 and phase policies.

R3 — docs/architecture/ui-v2/state-ownership.md:30-36,69-77 and provenance.md:14-28: Complete and correct the prototype extraction. The actual wizard uses f.clientId, f.secret, f.scanKey, f.endpoint and f.gwKey, not f.cred; the table also omits R2App credVal/credOpen, scan prompt/profile/results state, new-case fields and several wizard/account fields. Important behavioral changes are undeclared, including mandatory OAuth becoming scan-key-first, hosted Academy replacing the local account/quiz flow, and the read-only mcp fixture becoming a write call. This leaves credential entry and tenant-sensitive state without an auditable assignment despite C27's explicit exhaustive-coverage requirement. Acceptance: inventory every actual prototype state key, explicitly classify renamed/removed/derived fields, give owner/scope/lifetime and native credential-entry paths, and record all behavioral deviations with owning chunks and acceptance assertions.

R4 — docs/architecture/ui-v2/screens/reviews-administration.md:35-53; docs/planning/chunks/C31.md:19: Ground rotation in supported remote operations and explicit secret custody. The specification promises an old-key grace deadline, later revocation and recovery from Keychain, then calls the operator-confirmation timestamp a revocation time. The retained core distinguishes regenerate from creating an additional key (changes.rs:842-846; management.rs:980-988), and DESIGN.md:1133-1137 explicitly says issued keys are never persisted. No new contract establishes the promised grace/revoke sequence or vault storage. Acceptance: specify the exact supported sequence or an explicit blocked capability/dependency gate; define scoped protected storage and failure recovery if persistence is introduced; distinguish deployment acknowledgement from evidence of remote revocation; name tests for denied storage, failed/unknown issuance or revocation, context retirement and stable truthful timestamps.

R5 — docs/architecture/ui-v2/screens/api-client-test-cases.md:18-21 and chunks/C33.md:20: Preserve the Runtime-only execution boundary. The contract currently gives cases a Run action that scans them without a product restriction. The frozen R2App:1035-1037 explicitly uses Open in Playground only for Runtime and Inspect for other products, matching the accepted parity/workflow contracts. Acceptance: specify Runtime-only scan handoff and inspect-only non-Runtime specifications, with named cases asserting that non-Runtime rows never dispatch a scan or claim execution.

R6 — docs/architecture/ui-v2/DESIGN-V2.md:20-22; screens/wizard.md:21-26; screens/reviews-administration.md:9-17; chunks/C30.md and C31.md: Resolve the unsupported-product boundary. The specification describes six-product verification, inventories and administration as presentation over existing services, but provides no service/contract mapping or unsupported classification for new AIS/AES inventories and policy workflows. The existing ManagementResource, GatewayRead and ChangeKind interfaces do not supply those general product APIs. Prototype fixtures cannot establish these capabilities. Acceptance: map every product/tab/action to an existing admitted service and exact external contract, or explicitly mark it unavailable/preview with a consuming dependency gate; define fixture/native assertions that missing support or authority never becomes invented inventory, successful verification or an enabled mutation.
evidence_gaps: E1 — docs/planning/reviews/C27/attempt-01/request.json and the hashed c27-cargo.log: The log corroborates the reported 22 and 44 passing test counts, but supplies no source-bound run record, tool/environment identities or numeric exit records (the LIB EXIT and SC EXIT lines are blank). The packet's scoped source inventory excludes other xtask/core inputs that those tests compile; its dependency fingerprint hashes Cargo.lock alone. Retain exact commands, working directory, features/toolchain, raw exits and before/after hashes covering the compiled inputs, using a reproducible scoped snapshot or regenerated controller evidence. The documented full-check fallback is acknowledged; an unrun xtask check is not counted as passed.
